name: 月影奇缘
english_description: The login banner also reads "Century Journey to the West: Moon Love Story" — a venerable MUD adapted from the Journey to the West mythos. It belongs to the ES II engine series (sharing lineage with this project's es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, and xo, with the master file's authorship traceable back through developer "Lil" to "Annihilator").
